theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the clear momentum leader with a confirming trend and high durability. Passing the absolute-trend gate supports staying with the trend for drawdown control. Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=2.13) is extreme; a negative catalyst could trigger sharp mean reversion even within a trending structure.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners show high durability and full breadth without crowding, suggesting a stable uptrend despite a mixed Hurst tag. The absolute-trend gate is passed, aligning with the validated risk-control edge.
theses.dissent: The 'mixed' Hurst exponent and the potential divergence between silver mining equities and the underlying metal price could undermine trend persistence.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 3% over any 10-day period before 2026-09-23.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma exhibits a clean trend, high durability, full breadth, and no crowding, fitting the detector's ideal profile for staying-power. The theme has passed the absolute-trend gate, so continued participation is justified.
theses.dissent: Legislative or regulatory shocks on drug pricing pose an exogenous risk that can break any technical trend without warning.

falsifier.text: PPH trails the S&P 500 by 4% over any 15-day period before 2026-09-08.
